runtime: Standalone single-thread Cell CPU, Apple M3 Max, rustc 1.94.0, release --locked, sparse-cells + view-ports, same frozen 64-unit input. No PGO in these measurements.
requested_allocation_note: Diagnostic allocator counts each live Rust allocation once and attributes it by allocation origin, retaining origin through realloc. Capacities, not logical elements, are charged. Category peaks are independent. Rust requested bytes omit C allocations, allocator metadata, fragmentation and the instrumentation header. Tagged timings/RSS are excluded from paired results.
